description: LAWFUL DEVELOPMENT CERTIFICATE FOR PROPOSED HIP GABLE AND REAR DORMER ROOF EXTENSION WITH JULIET BALCONY, ONE VELUX ON FRONT
decision_conditions:
<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Enlargement of a dwelling house (Class B) </span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">- The operations&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">comprising
a rear dormer and hip to gable conversion&nbsp;</span>would consist of the enlargement of a dwelling house
within the meaning of Class B of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town &amp; Country
Planning (General Permitted Development)&nbsp;
(England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the
development tolerances set out in said Class B. The operation would therefore
have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.</p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Alteration to the roof of the dwelling house (Class C)</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The operations&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">comprising
1 rooflight to the front roof slope&nbsp;</span>would consist of any other alteration to the roof of the
dwelling house within the meaning of Class C of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the
Town &amp; Country Planning (General Permitted Development)&nbsp; (England) Order 2015 "the Order"
and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class C. The
operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of
the Order.</p>
